scenarios.name: Keep the ribbon below the application bar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the quick access toolbar is configured to appear above the ribbon
the ribbon is docked at the top in its expanded Normal appearance
File and the ribbon tabs appear on a separate row beneath the application bar
the active tab's command panels are below the ribbon tab row
the window controls remain in the application bar
